options.feedback: Also buys you two seconds and everybody uses it. The answer that follows is the true one anyway.
It is. It is also the sentence that ends the conversation instead of opening it.

steps.speaker: Reto
steps.es: Soll ich es auf Englisch erklären?
steps.en: Shall I explain it in English?

options.es: Bitte nicht. Ich brauche das Deutsch.
options.en: Please do not. I need the German.
options.feedback: Say it. He means well and he does not know, and nobody will do this part for you.
It is easier and it is the wrong direction. In English you are a different person, and they will meet that one instead.
Clear and slightly cold. One more sentence saying why turns a refusal into a reason.

steps.speaker: Marianne
steps.en: I will just talk more slowly.

options.es: Sie können normal reden. Ich frage, wenn etwas fehlt.
options.en: You can talk normally. I will ask if I miss something.
options.feedback: Kind and it hands the job back to you, which is where it belongs. She will do it, too.
Sometimes it does. It also tells the table you are not keeping up, which is the part that stings.
Today you do not. Pretending puts you back in the same position in twenty minutes.
He said one word to a table of nine and it settled the matter. Nothing more is needed from you.
Fine. He did not do it as a favour, he did it because he agreed.
He closed it. Reopening it to agree with him is the one thing that could unclose it.

scenarios.title: Der Vierundzwanzigste
scenarios.desc: Nine people, real candles, and a bucket
scenarios.setting: A living room in Kriens at six in the evening, a tree with actual fire on it, and the lights going off.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.es: Für jeden etwas Kleines. Zwanzig Franken.
steps.en: Something small for everybody. Twenty francs.

options.feedback: It is not. A present that is too big makes pressure, and everybody at that table knows the number.
Nine people and a ceiling. That is the whole brief and it is a kindness to be given it.

options.es: Ich kaufe deinen Eltern etwas Richtiges.
options.en: I will buy your parents something proper.
options.feedback: The screwdriver from the Brockenhaus cost eight francs and he still uses it. Price is not the axis here.
One at a time, everybody watching, an hour for nine people. Sitting through it is the participation.
No. Presents, then three hours of fondue. The order is not negotiable and nobody will explain it.
Somebody will. Asking is fine and the answer is already decided and nobody said so.

steps.speaker: Kurt
steps.es: Der ist von vor dem Krieg. Den gibt es heute nicht mehr.
steps.en: That is from before the war. They do not make those any more.

options.feedback: That is the longest sentence he will say all evening. It is also, from him, the whole thank you.

options.es: Ich habe ihn im Brockenhaus gefunden.
options.en: I found it in the Brockenhaus.
options.feedback: He will like that better than a shop. Say it plainly and stop.
He said two sentences about a screwdriver. Asking again makes him say a third, and he will not.

steps.speaker: Grossmutter
steps.es: Grau. Für einen Mann geht nur grau.
steps.en: Grey. For a man only grey will do.

options.en: Thank you very much. They are lovely.
options.feedback: She started them in October, before she had met you. That is the part the socks are actually about.
She did, and she has been waiting all evening for somebody to ask.
She is ninety-one, she has an opinion about wool, and this is not the moment to test it.

scenarios.title: Wie geht es?
scenarios.desc: There is a whole scale under this
scenarios.setting: An office in Kriens in February, sixteen days of fog, and a colleague who has stopped typing.

options.feedback: Two words and the whole afternoon changes. Es geht is the answer that says: ask again.
The greeting with more words in it. Nothing wrong with it and nothing happens after it.
The bottom of the scale. It is honest and it is a lot to hand somebody at ten in the morning.
Small and true. He will not push and he will know exactly what you mean, because he has it too.
He turned round in his chair for this. Kompliziert sends him back to the screen.

options.es: Alles. Ich weiss nicht mehr, was ich hier mache.
options.en: Everything. I do not know what I am doing here any more.
options.feedback: That is the real answer. It is also more than the question was built to carry, and he will listen anyway.

steps.speaker: Marco
steps.es: Ja. Der Februar ist der schlimmste.

options.feedback: Ask. The useful part is not the sympathy, it is finding out that everybody here is like this in February.
He was not asking to be reassured. He was telling you something, and it was the useful thing.

options.es: Ich dachte, das liegt an mir.
options.en: I thought it was just me.
options.feedback: Honest, and it is why he said it. Alle sind so is the whole medicine here.
One word. With him that is the entire language for this and anything longer would spoil it.
He knows. Refusing a small kindness here makes the other person carry it back.

options.en: Say nothing and get back to work.
options.feedback: Fine, and a merci costs nothing. He brought it across the room.

scenarios.title: Bleibst du?
scenarios.desc: Asked over potatoes, which is how the big ones arrive
scenarios.setting: A kitchen on a Sunday, two knives, and a question that has been waiting since November.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.es: Und bist du im Juli überhaupt noch da?
steps.en: And will you even still be here in July?

options.feedback: She has asked since November and you have not answered since November. A question back is the fourth dodge.

options.es: Mein Vertrag läuft im September aus.
options.en: My contract runs out in September.
options.feedback: The real fact, said out loud for the first time. She already knew the date. You had never spoken it.

options.en: Of course I am still here.
options.feedback: Warm and it skips the paperwork. Staying here is a contract and a permit, not a feeling.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.es: Ich frage seit November. Du antwortest nicht.
steps.en: I have been asking since November. You do not answer.

options.feedback: She is. Three times she asked and three times you heard a different question.
True, and it is not much of a defence. She noticed all three times.

options.en: I did not have an answer.
options.feedback: Also true, and it is the honest version of the same thing. She will take it.
One word, said before you have thought about it, and still true two minutes later. That is the answer.
She will say that is not the question. Between wanting and doing there is a great deal of paper.
The honest answer for a year. She is asking whether it is still the honest answer today.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.en: Then we have to do something.

options.feedback: She is already getting a sheet of paper. A list here is a declaration; joining in on it is the answer.
Twenty minutes after the biggest question of your life, yes. That is not coldness, it is how it is meant.
Said as a joke and it is also true. Somebody who makes a list has already decided.

scenarios.title: Station C
scenarios.desc: Four people, and none of them is the one who knows
scenarios.setting: The reception desk of a hospital at ten past seven in the evening, and a name you have said out loud only in a stairwell.

steps.speaker: Am Empfang
steps.en: Hello. What is the patient's name?

options.feedback: The surname first, then both. That is what she needs to type and it is all she needs.
True, and it is the answer to the next question, not this one. She asked for a name.

options.en: I am looking for an old woman.
options.feedback: There are four hundred people in this building. Give her the name.
Say it plainly. It is not nothing here, and it is enough to be told the ward.
It would work. It is also a lie that somebody will repeat back to you in a corridor.
It does, and she is not being nosy. She has to decide what she is allowed to tell you.

steps.speaker: Eine Pflegerin
steps.es: Zu wem möchten Sie? Die Besuchszeit ist bald vorbei.
steps.en: Who would you like to see? Visiting time is nearly over.

options.es: Zu Frau Amrein. Ich weiss, es ist spät.
options.en: To Frau Amrein. I know it is late.
options.feedback: Naming the problem yourself is what gets you the ten minutes.
Fine, and she still does not know who you want.
Nobody sent you away. Ten minutes are something too.

steps.speaker: Eine Pflegerin
steps.es: Zimmer dreihundertzwölf. Aber wirklich nur kurz.
steps.en: Room three hundred and twelve. But really only briefly.

options.feedback: Two words, and they are the right two.
You will not get an answer, and she will not hold it against you. Ask the doctor or ask her.
You just did. Go up.

scenarios.title: Zwanzig Minuten
scenarios.desc: Sitting with somebody, and getting the questions wrong
scenarios.setting: A hospital room with two beds, a window facing east, and a chair that somebody fetched.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Du hast Blumen gekauft. Das musst du nicht.
steps.en: You bought flowers. You do not have to.

options.es: Ich habe die Zeitung auch dabei.
options.en: I have the newspaper with me too.
options.feedback: Move past it. The paper is the better present anyway and she will read it right through.
Warm, and it keeps the fuss going for another minute she does not want.
An excuse, and an invented one. She will remember it.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Es hat den ganzen Tag Nebel gehabt.

options.es: Ja, unten am See war es grau.
options.en: Yes, down by the lake it was grey.
options.feedback: The weather is the vehicle, not the subject. Get in and let her drive.
She knows how she is. She is the only person in the room who knows exactly.
Twice now you have asked past what she offered you.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Und? Was war bei dir heute?
steps.en: And? What happened with you today?

options.feedback: Ordinary, small, and exactly what she asked for. She wants a voice running.
That closes the only door she opened.
Kind, and it hands her the work she was trying to hand you.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: So. Jetzt reicht es. Diese Suppe ist ein Skandal.
steps.en: Right. That is enough now. That soup is a scandal.

options.feedback: Follow her out. That is how she ends every evening and it is how you know to go.
She will say no. Bring it on Thursday anyway.

options.es: Du hast doch vorher noch geredet.
options.feedback: She stopped on purpose. Twenty minutes is the visit.

scenarios.title: Es ist nicht wichtig
scenarios.desc: A request, taking four minutes to arrive
scenarios.setting: The eleventh evening on the same chair, and a Sunday she cannot get to.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Am Sonntag gehe ich immer auf den Friedhof. Jetzt geht das nicht.
steps.en: On Sunday I always go to the cemetery. That does not work now.

options.feedback: Kind, and it takes the asking away from her. Sometimes right. Not with her.

options.en: How long have you been doing that?
options.feedback: A real question, and it sends her somewhere else. She was going somewhere.
Say nothing and leave the room open. She needs the four minutes and she will use them.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Es ist nicht wichtig. Du hast sicher keine Zeit.
steps.en: It is not important. You certainly have no time.

options.feedback: Take the way out away, once, and wait. She will get there.
Honest, and it makes her start the whole approach again.
She built you an exit out of politeness and you walked through it.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Könntest du am Sonntag hingehen? Die Blumen musst du nicht kaufen.
steps.en: Could you go there on Sunday? You do not have to buy the flowers.

options.feedback: Two words. Anything longer makes her feel the size of what she asked.

options.en: Of course, gladly, no problem at all.
options.feedback: Warm, and three times too much. It tells her the favour was big.

options.es: Und was mache ich dort genau?
options.en: And what exactly do I do there?
options.feedback: Fair, and she has already told you: the can is at the fountain, third row.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Und sag ihm Grüezi von mir.
steps.en: And say Grüezi to him from me.

options.feedback: She said it the way you send a greeting to a neighbour. Take it the same way.
Now it is a moment, and she was trying very hard for it not to be one.
She talks to him every morning. She told you that two years ago.

scenarios.title: Herzliches Beileid
scenarios.desc: A queue, and the same two words forty times
scenarios.setting: The door of a church on a Tuesday afternoon, four hundred people, and rain that nobody is putting an umbrella up against.

options.feedback: The formula, and the hand, one second longer. Nothing else is needed and nothing else is wanted.

options.es: Sie war ein besonderer Mensch für mich.
options.en: She was a special person to me.
options.feedback: True, and it asks her for a reply she has already given two hundred times today.

options.es: Ich weiss, wie Sie sich fühlen.
options.feedback: You do not, and it is the one sentence that is wrong in every language.
The whole answer. Everybody here places you with it immediately.
Also true, and it makes him work out where you fit. Neighbour is the word they use.
Modesty that makes the other person carry it. She talked about you.
He lived below her for eleven years. He lost something as well and he just told you so.
Not wrong. It just takes the thing he offered you and keeps it.
True and it fills the space he left for the two of you.

steps.speaker: Vreni
steps.es: Wenn Sie etwas brauchen, melden Sie sich.
steps.en: If you need anything, get in touch.

options.es: Und wenn ich etwas machen kann, sagen Sie es.
options.en: And if I can do anything, tell me.
options.feedback: Only say it if you mean it, because she will come back to you on it. Two days later she does.
Fine, and it ends the exchange one step early.

options.es: Sie haben jetzt genug zu tun.
options.en: You have enough to do now.
options.feedback: Meant kindly. It also decides for her what she can manage.

scenarios.title: Zwei Kisten
scenarios.desc: A flat in a morning, and what goes in the boxes
scenarios.setting: Three rooms, six people, and a van outside with the back doors open.

steps.speaker: Vreni
steps.es: Das kommt alles ins Brockenhaus. Ausser was in die Kisten geht.
steps.en: That is all going to the second-hand shop. Except what goes in the boxes.

options.en: What should go in the boxes?
options.feedback: Ask before you decide. It is her sister and they are her two boxes.
Nobody has offered you anything yet. Two hours later she does.
It is, and the rent runs on either way. She will tell you the arithmetic if you let her.

steps.speaker: Vreni
steps.es: Die Fotos vom Kasten. Legst du sie hinein?
steps.en: The photos from the sideboard. Will you put them in?

options.feedback: Say yes and put them in one at a time. She is watching, and that is the job.

options.en: Do you not want to do it yourself?
options.feedback: She asked you on purpose. She has been doing this since seven in the morning.

options.es: Der da ist ihr Mann, oder?
options.en: That one is her husband, isn't it?
options.feedback: It is, and now is not the hour for it. Ask her in a café in three weeks.

steps.speaker: Ruedi Zemp
steps.es: Nehmen Sie vorne, ich nehme hinten.
steps.en: You take the front, I will take the back.

options.feedback: He has carried furniture down this staircase for twenty years. Take the end you are given.

options.en: I can take the back as well.
options.feedback: You cannot, and he knows the second turn better than you do.

options.en: Should we do it with three?
options.feedback: Sensible for the cupboard. For a table it makes the stairs worse.
Stay for it. Standing in an empty kitchen with a paper cup is most of what today was for.
You took the day off. She knows, because you told her at eight.
Sie, still, after a morning of this. And it is a very large question for a paper cup.

scenarios.title: Ich möchte etwas ansprechen
scenarios.desc: Twenty minutes, asked for two days in advance
scenarios.setting: A small meeting room at two o'clock, and four sentences written down the night before.

options.en: I would like to raise something.
options.feedback: The sentence it starts with. He now knows this is the thing and not small talk.
Kind, and it makes the next sentence harder to say.
You asked on Tuesday and he is sitting here. Start.

options.es: Ja. Letzte Woche ist es zweimal passiert.
options.en: Yes. It happened twice last week.
options.feedback: A number and an example. That makes it a matter and not a quarrel.
Immer is a word about a person. He will defend himself and you will lose the point.

options.es: Ja, aber es ist nicht so schlimm.
options.en: Yes, but it is not that bad.
options.feedback: You have just taken it back. He will believe you and nothing changes.

steps.speaker: Simon
steps.es: Das tut mir leid. Ich rede zu viel, ich mache das bei allen.
steps.en: I am sorry. I talk too much, I do it to everybody.

options.feedback: Sachlich and true. He says it himself thirty seconds later, and it is better if he does.
Then it was not worth two days of not sleeping.

options.en: Yes, that is right, with everybody.
options.feedback: Generous, and it lets the actual thing go by.

steps.speaker: Simon
steps.es: Und wie machen wir es jetzt?
steps.en: And how do we do it now?

options.es: Ich möchte meine Sachen selber sagen.
options.en: I would like to say my own things myself.
options.feedback: The fourth sentence you wrote down. Plain, and it asks for one thing.
The same thing, aimed at him instead of at the situation.
You asked for the meeting. Bring the answer to that question with you.

scenarios.title: Ich hätte eine Bitte
scenarios.desc: Four messages, two hours, and four yeses
scenarios.setting: A Monday evening, a phone, and a Saturday you have been planning to do alone for three weeks.

options.en: I have a favour to ask.
options.feedback: The opening. It warns him something is coming and it gives him room to say no.
Two hours to write the message and then you take it back in five words.
Fine, and it makes him say yes before he knows to what. Say the thing.

options.es: Könntest du mir am Samstag beim Umzug helfen?
options.en: Could you help me with the move on Saturday?
options.feedback: What, and when. Nothing else belongs in this sentence.

options.es: Ich weiss, du hast sicher viel zu tun, aber...
options.en: I know you have a lot on, but...
options.feedback: You are arguing against yourself before he has said anything.

options.es: Kennst du jemanden mit einem Camion?
options.en: Do you know anybody with a van?
options.feedback: Asking sideways. He will answer the question you asked and not the one you have.
A time and the payment. That is the whole arrangement and everybody here knows it.

options.es: Bist du sicher? Es ist ein ganzer Tag.
options.en: Are you sure? It is a whole day.
options.feedback: He said klar. Asking again makes him say it twice and helps nobody.
Money for this is an insult. Food and drink, and that is not a joke.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Und? Was ist mit dem Rücken?

options.feedback: Say it. Nobody will mention it again and nobody will let you near the cupboard.
He will not believe it and he will hand you a carton anyway.
Nobody is going to let you. Beat decides that at nine in the morning.

scenarios.title: Im Mai geht es nicht
scenarios.desc: Saying no to somebody who is allowed to ask
scenarios.setting: A Sunday telephone call at six, and a date that has stopped being far away.

steps.speaker: Deine Mutter
steps.es: Die zweite Woche im Mai. Zehn Tage. Ich habe schon geschaut.
steps.en: The second week in May. Ten days. I have already had a look.

options.feedback: Plain, and first. Everything else comes after it and none of it is an excuse.

options.es: Im Mai habe ich sehr viel im Büro.
options.en: In May I have a lot on at the office.
options.feedback: Almost true, which is what makes it an excuse. She will come back to it.

options.en: Ten days is a long time.
options.feedback: It is the real problem and it lands as a complaint about her.

options.es: Seit Januar ist zu viel passiert.
options.en: Since January too much has happened.
options.feedback: The truth, in six words. She is sixty-seven and she understands it immediately.
The second excuse in one call. Now the first one is not believed either.
Honest, and it leaves her holding a no with nothing in it.
A no with a date is an appointment. A no without one is a door.
Vielleicht means no here, and it leaves her waiting for it.

options.es: Ich melde mich, wenn es besser geht.
options.en: I will let you know when things are better.
options.feedback: Kind, and it puts the whole thing back on your side of the table.

steps.speaker: Deine Mutter
steps.es: Und? Geht es der Selina gut?

options.es: Ja. Sie fragt jede Woche nach dir.
options.en: Yes. She asks about you every week.
options.feedback: She changed the subject, which means it is settled. Go with her.
She is not. Asking makes the no into something that has to be defended.

options.es: Es tut mir wirklich leid wegen dem Mai.
options.en: I am really sorry about May.
options.feedback: Once was enough. Twice starts taking it back.

scenarios.title: Dann halt später
scenarios.desc: A cancelled train, and the word that closes it
scenarios.setting: Platform four on a Tuesday morning, a board that says Fällt aus, and twenty-two minutes.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Der fällt aus. Der nächste geht um zwanzig nach.
steps.en: That one is cancelled. The next goes at twenty past.

options.en: Then we will just go later.
options.feedback: The whole sentence. There is a shrug in the middle of it and it closes the subject.
A complaint is allowed and this one is a bit long and a bit true. Two minutes, then stop.
For twenty-two minutes. He will not say anything and he will remember it.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Das ist diese Woche schon das zweite Mal.
steps.en: That is the second time this week.

options.feedback: Agreement, no enthusiasm, and it hands the subject back to him. Exactly the right size.

options.es: Ja, absolut, das ist wirklich unmöglich.
options.en: Yes, absolutely, that really is impossible.
options.feedback: Three times too much. He was making conversation, not an argument.

options.es: Bei uns zu Hause wäre das normal.
options.en: At home that would be normal.
options.feedback: Comparing your old country to this one, out loud, over four minutes. It never lands well.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.en: Do you want to get a coffee?

options.es: Ja, gern. Ich gehe mal schauen.
options.en: Yes, gladly. I will go and have a look.
options.feedback: Mal, in the middle, doing nothing and softening the whole thing.
Fine, and it leaves him standing on a platform for twenty minutes with nothing.

options.en: But we do not have time.
options.feedback: Doch in the middle is a reproach here. You have twenty-two minutes.
The number, exactly. He will send you the difference this evening and mean it.
It does. Nobody here wants to carry even a small debt, and refusing to say makes one.

options.en: Will you get the next one?
options.feedback: Warm, and it turns four fifty into an arrangement. Just say the number.

scenarios.title: Nicht schlecht
scenarios.desc: Praise arriving at a size you did not expect
scenarios.setting: A Sunday table in Kriens, five people, and the first thing you have ever cooked for them.

options.feedback: Not wrong. It also stops the exchange one step early, and there was a step left.

options.es: Es ist ein bisschen zu salzig.
options.en: It is a bit too salty.
options.feedback: Make it smaller and let him make it bigger again. That is the dance and he knows the steps.
That is the top of his scale. Asking for more turns the best thing he says into a disappointment.
The list, and the modesty in front of it. Both are expected and neither is a lie.

options.es: Ein altes Rezept von meiner Grossmutter.
options.en: An old recipe of my grandmother's.
options.feedback: A story where a list was asked for. She will ask again in a minute.
A joke that reads as a wall. She asked because she wants to make it.

steps.speaker: Reto
steps.en: Can you do that again some time?

options.feedback: Yes, and a mal in the middle so it is not a commitment with a date on it.

options.es: Wenn ihr wollt, mache ich das jeden Sonntag.
options.en: If you like, I will do it every Sunday.
options.feedback: Far too much, and it puts them under an obligation they did not ask for.
Modesty is right, and he asked a question. Answer it as well.

steps.speaker: Kurt
steps.es: Du kochst besser als der Reto.

options.en: That is not a high bar.
options.feedback: Teasing back, at the person who is in the room, once. Reto will laugh and take more.

options.en: Thank you, that really pleases me.
options.feedback: Accepting it flat, in front of the person it was measured against.
Deflection is right and this one contradicts him instead of moving past it.

scenarios.title: Vier Minuten
scenarios.desc: Believing something ridiculous, in public
scenarios.setting: A long table after a rehearsal, five people, and a story delivered at the volume of a weather report.

steps.speaker: Beat
steps.es: Im Winter bauen sie die Brücke ab. Wegen dem Eis.
steps.en: In winter they take the bridge down. Because of the ice.

options.feedback: Friendly, short, and the best defence there is. About half the time you will be wrong.

options.es: Und wie kommt man dann über den Fluss?
options.en: And how do you get across the river then?
options.feedback: You are in. It is not a disaster: the four minutes are the joke and you are giving them to him.
Right, and sharp. Doch in the middle turns it into an accusation.

steps.speaker: Beat
steps.es: Doch, doch. Jedes Jahr im November, Stück für Stück.
steps.en: Oh yes. Every year in November, piece by piece.

options.es: Und im März wieder auf, ja?
options.en: And back up again in March, is it?
options.feedback: You have found it and you are playing along instead of announcing it. That is the whole art.
The question that hands him the table. Everybody will laugh and it will be fine.

options.es: Ich weiss, dass das nicht stimmt.
options.en: I know that is not true.
options.feedback: Announcing that you spotted it ends the joke and makes it about you.

steps.speaker: Fatlum
steps.es: Er macht das mit allen. Beim ersten Mal glauben es alle.
steps.en: He does that with everybody. The first time everybody believes it.

options.feedback: Grumble and laugh along. That is the answer, and it is over in two seconds.

options.es: Bei uns macht man solche Witze nicht.
options.en: We do not make jokes like that where I come from.
options.feedback: They only do it to people they have decided about. That sentence turns a welcome into a complaint.

options.es: Wie lange geht das schon so?
options.en: How long has this been going on?
options.feedback: Fine, and it keeps the spotlight on you for another minute.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Nach drei Jahren tönt er immer noch wie ein Wetterbericht.
steps.en: After three years he still sounds like a weather report.

options.en: On the other hand the Germans understand me.
options.feedback: Six words, at the person who started it, once. Two seconds of silence and then it lands.

options.es: Ich rede halt langsam, das ist normal beim Lernen.
options.en: I just talk slowly, that is normal when you are learning.
options.feedback: True, and explaining is the one thing that cannot be funny.

options.es: Und du tönst wie ein Traktor.
options.en: And you sound like a tractor.
options.feedback: Right shape, wrong aim: it says nothing back about what he actually said.

scenarios.title: Und das bei diesen Preisen
scenarios.desc: Two minutes of agreeing with a stranger
scenarios.setting: Platform two at twenty past seven, a board reading plus four, and a man you have never spoken to.

options.es: Und am Montag war es auch schon.
options.en: And on Monday it happened too.
options.feedback: Agree and add one. That is the whole form and it lasts about two minutes.

options.es: Es sind ja nur vier Minuten.
options.feedback: Correct, and it is the one thing that is not allowed. He was not asking to be right.
Not wrong, and it leaves him holding the conversation on his own.
The strongest thing you can say here and it is one syllable.

options.es: Dafür fährt fast immer alles pünktlich.
options.en: On the other hand almost everything runs on time.
options.feedback: True, and it is the second correction. He will turn away and be perfectly polite about it.
The other fixed line. Interchangeable, and it keeps the two minutes going.
A fact, small, and it is how a platform acquaintance starts. You will nod at him for years.

options.es: Ich bin erst seit drei Jahren hier.
options.en: I have only been here three years.
options.feedback: An answer to a question he did not ask. He asked about the train.
He is making conversation on a platform. That reads as suspicion.
One word, dry, and it ends the two minutes cleanly. He will laugh through his nose.

options.es: Endlich. Das war wirklich zu viel.
options.en: Finally. That really was too much.
options.feedback: Still going at minute four. The form is over when the train arrives.
Warm and a bit large for a man you complained with. A nod does it.

scenarios.title: Hinter der Grinde
scenarios.desc: Half an hour with nobody knowing where you are from
scenarios.setting: A pub on Schmutziger Donnerstag at nine in the evening, twenty-five yellow costumes, and a mask you can barely see out of.

options.es: In der da hinten. Die Gelben.
options.en: That one back there. The yellow ones.
options.feedback: Point and answer. Behind a mask nobody is asking anything else, and that is the whole point.

options.es: Ich bin erst seit einem Jahr dabei.
options.en: I have only been in it for a year.
options.feedback: Nobody asked. It is the sentence you have been saying for three years and tonight you do not need it.
He could not tell. You just told him, and that is the one thing the mask was doing for you.

options.es: Trommel. Auf zwei und auf vier.
options.en: Drum. On two and on four.
options.feedback: The joke every single person in this room knows, told flat. He will laugh.
Say it once and then stop. Twice is asking somebody to argue with you.

options.es: Ich habe als Kind Klavier gelernt.
options.en: I learnt the piano as a child.
options.feedback: A CV where a one-word answer goes. It is loud in here and he has a beer.

steps.speaker: Jemand in der Beiz
steps.es: Kennst du den Erwin? Der spielt bei euch.
steps.en: Do you know Erwin? He plays with you.

options.es: Klar. Der mit der grossen Trompete.
options.en: Sure. The one with the big trumpet.
options.feedback: Yes, and one detail. That is how a stranger finds out you actually belong there.

options.en: No, I do not know him.
options.feedback: Twenty-five people and you have been going a year. He will believe you and wonder.

options.en: I do not know everybody yet.
options.feedback: Honest and it is the third sentence tonight that puts you outside the group.

steps.speaker: Jemand in der Beiz
steps.es: Nimmst du die Grinde nicht ab? Es ist heiss hier.
steps.en: Are you not taking the mask off? It is hot in here.

options.feedback: Taking it off in a conversation makes the conversation serious. Everybody here knows that rule.
Fine. Also the end of the half hour where nobody could hear where you are from.

options.es: Ich sehe damit fast nichts, aber es ist besser so.
options.en: I can hardly see with it, but it is better this way.
options.feedback: True, and it explains something that works better unexplained.

scenarios.title: Ich sehe das anders
scenarios.desc: Disagreeing without it becoming about a person
scenarios.setting: A club meeting on a Tuesday, eleven people, six hundred francs and forty minutes.

steps.speaker: Ein Mann vom Vorstand
steps.es: Also machen wir das so. Sind alle einverstanden?
steps.en: So we will do it that way. Is everybody agreed?

options.feedback: Four words, very calm. They attack nobody and give up nothing, and the room will make space.
Put flat on the table it decides for everybody. Watch what the room does with it.

options.es: Ich weiss nicht, ob ich das gut finde.
options.en: I do not know whether I think that is good.
options.feedback: Honest and shapeless. Say what you see and let them answer it.

options.es: Mir scheint, das kostet uns nächstes Jahr mehr.
options.en: It seems to me that will cost us more next year.
options.feedback: An opening that says this is mine, and then a reason with a number in it.

options.es: Weil es einfach keinen Sinn macht.
options.en: Because it simply makes no sense.
options.feedback: Einfach and no reason. That is the sentence that ends a discussion and wins nothing.

options.es: Das habe ich vorhin doch gesagt.
options.feedback: Doch in the middle, at somebody who is chairing. It reads as a complaint about him.

steps.speaker: Margrit
steps.es: Da hat er recht. Das haben wir letztes Jahr auch gehabt.
steps.en: He is right there. We had that last year too.

options.feedback: She has just supported you without meaning to. One syllable takes it and moves on.

options.en: Exactly, that is what I mean.
options.feedback: Fine and a bit eager. Ja in there makes it sound like you were waiting.
Thanking somebody for agreeing turns a matter into two sides with members.
You will probably lose and it will be over. Whoever loses often writes the minutes.

options.es: Können wir noch einmal darüber reden?
options.en: Can we talk about it again?
options.feedback: You have said it. A second round is where a matter starts turning into a person.

options.es: Ich bin dagegen, das ist klar.
options.en: I am against it, that is clear.
options.feedback: They know. Saying it again just before the vote adds nothing.

kennen.en: to know a person or place

phrases.en: I only speak a little German.

phrases.es: Bitte langsam. Ich verstehe nicht alles.
phrases.en: Slowly, please. I do not understand everything.

phrases.es: 1414 ist die Rega, die Rettung aus der Luft.
phrases.en: 1414 is the Rega, the air rescue.

emergency.title: If you are hurt or ill

phrases.es: Man hat mir das Portemonnaie gestohlen.
Ich habe den letzten Zug verpasst.
phrases.en: I have missed the last train.

phrases.es: Ich weiss nicht, wo ich bin.
phrases.en: I do not know where I am.

phrases.es: Wir sind auf dem Berg und kommen nicht weiter.
phrases.en: We are on the mountain and cannot go on.

phrases.es: Es wird dunkel und wir haben kein Licht.
phrases.en: It is getting dark and we have no light.
I am sending you my location.
We will stay here and wait.

momo.en: Not seen you in a while
I am standing in the meadow
That is how it is done
I do not feel like it
I am in a club too
We say du to each other
In summer I am up top
With me it is all right
I have confetti in my coat
Do not get up at five
